description: This source file defines the MarkerRenderer class responsible for rendering various marker styles in charts using the PdfSharp library. It contains methods to draw different shapes like squares, diamonds, triangles, plus signs, circles, dots, dashes, X shapes, and stars, all centered at a specified position.

classes.name: MarkerRenderer
classes.description: A static class responsible for rendering chart markers of various styles onto a graphics surface.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws a marker at the specified position with the style and colors defined in rendererInfo.
